hook.en: In a group discussion, saying "You're wrong!" can end the conversation. Saying "I see your point, but…" keeps it going — and earns better marks.
hook.bm: Dalam perbincangan kumpulan, berkata "You're wrong!" boleh menamatkan perbualan. Berkata "I see your point, but…" mengekalkannya — dan mendapat markah lebih baik.

bigIdeas.en: Use polite phrases to give opinions and disagree respectfully.
bigIdeas.bm: Gunakan frasa sopan untuk memberi pendapat dan tidak bersetuju dengan hormat.

bigIdeas.en: Suggestions, requests and offers each have useful sentence starters.
bigIdeas.bm: Cadangan, permintaan dan tawaran masing-masing mempunyai permulaan ayat yang berguna.

bigIdeas.en: Good listeners predict, note key words and ask for clarification when unsure.
bigIdeas.bm: Pendengar yang baik meramal, mencatat kata kunci dan meminta penjelasan apabila tidak pasti.

definition.en: Letting others speak and responding to them.
definition.bm: Memberi peluang orang lain bercakap dan memberi respons.

definition.en: Asking someone to repeat or explain.
Important words to listen for: names, numbers, times.
definition.bm: Perkataan penting untuk didengar: nama, nombor, masa.

definition.en: "Well…", "Let me think…" give you time to think politely.
definition.bm: "Well…", "Let me think…" memberi masa untuk berfikir dengan sopan.

question.en: Your friend says, "We should ban phones in school." You partly disagree. Respond politely.
question.bm: Kawan anda berkata, "We should ban phones in school." Anda tidak bersetuju sepenuhnya. Beri respons dengan sopan.

steps.en: Give your view with a reason.

answer.en: I see your point, but phones can help us research. Maybe we could allow them only during lessons?
answer.bm: I see your point, but phones can help us research. Maybe we could allow them only during lessons?
